blocks.h2: Shower Repair Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: Can you work on a clawfoot tub shower?
items.answer: Yes. We repair and replace exposed risers, diverters and tub fillers on clawfoot setups.

items.q: Can you fix my shower without tearing out tile?
items.answer: Usually. Cartridges come out through the trim. A full valve replacement may need a small access panel.

items.q: Why does my shower get hot when someone flushes?
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure, and newer ones can wear out. A pressure-balancing valve or cartridge fixes it.

items.q: Why is my shower leaking into the room below?
items.preview: A valve, drain or connection behind the wall.
items.answer: Usually a leaking valve, a loose connection or a failed drain seal. We find the source and fix it.

items.q: Can you convert a tub to a shower in an old bathroom?
items.preview: Often, with a new valve and fittings.
items.answer: Often. We install the valve, riser and head and handle the plumbing side of the conversion. Tile or surround work is coordinated separately.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on the valve and parts. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the valve, the parts and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
